en.headline: Victoria Park lanterns stay lit through Mid-Autumn week
en.dek: The LCSD carnival and the Tourism Board's first International Lantern Spectacular run nightly until 27 September, with lighting extended to midnight on Friday.
body: Victoria Park remains the city's main Mid-Autumn lantern ground this week, with the Leisure and Cultural Services Department's carnival on soccer pitches 1 to 6 running nightly until 27 September and the Hong Kong Tourism Board's inaugural International Lantern Spectacular sharing the park.

Lanterns are lit from 6.30pm to 11pm, extended to midnight on Friday 25 September, the festival night itself. Admission is free. The LCSD display takes Hong Kong daily life and food as its theme. The Tourism Board installation pairs giant lanterns from Nanjing with festive pieces from 20 places, including a large banyan-tree lantern titled Shadowlight.

A Mid-Autumn creative market operates from 6.30pm to 11pm on 19 to 27 September. Friday's gala night runs from 7.30pm to 10.30pm, with the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance entering the park from 10.30pm to 11.30pm. Organisers said admission is first come, first served and that temporary crowd control will be used when the park is full. They advised people who mainly want to see the lanterns to come on a night other than Friday.

The Community Programmes Office listed prohibited items including open-flame lanterns, alcohol, metal balloons and glass bottles. Tin Hau MTR Exit A2 and Causeway Bay Exit E are the nearest stations. The carnival is part of the Chinese Culture Festival. Programme details may change without notice.

zh.headline: 維園綵燈會亮燈至中秋 周五延至午夜
zh.dek: 康文署中秋綵燈會及旅發局首屆國際綵燈匯演同步在維園舉行，展期至9月27日，中秋正日亮燈延長至午夜。
body: 維多利亞公園本周繼續是全城主要中秋賞燈地點。康樂及文化事務署的中秋綵燈會在一至六號足球場舉行，展期至9月27日；香港旅遊發展局首屆國際綵燈匯演亦在同一公園展出。
綵燈亮燈時間為晚上6時30分至11時，中秋正日9月25日（周五）延長至午夜12時，免費入場。康文署綵燈以香港生活及飲食為主題。旅發局展品則結合南京大型傳統綵燈，以及來自20個地方的節慶燈組，其中包括名為「Shadowlight」的大榔樹綵燈。
中秋創意市集於9月19日至27日晚上6時30分至11時開放。周五嘉年華夜由晚上7時30分至10時30分舉行，大坑舞火龍隊伍於晚上10時30分至11時30分進入維園。主辦單位表示入場以先到先得，人流過多時會實施臨時管制，並建議以賞燈為主的市民盡量選擇周五以外的日子到場。
社區節目辦事處列明場內禁止攜帶明火燈籠、酒精類飲品、金屬氣球及玻璃瓶等物品。最就近港鐵站為天后站A2出口及銅鑼灣站E出口。節目屬中華文化節活動之一，如有更改以主辦單位公布為準。
